title: Import and play a video
summary: Import a video, place it on a video track, and press Play: the Video panel shows the picture and the video's sound plays through its own track.
alternateQueries: How do I import a video?
Why is there no video window?
How do I play a video?

steps.instruction: Choose File > Import... and add the video (mp4, mov, mkv, avi, webm or m4v), or drop it on the Tracker.
steps.expectedResult: A progress window copies it into the project. Its original is kept and its sound is extracted as a WAV.

steps.instruction: If you imported without dropping, right-click a video track and choose Add Clip..., then pick the video.
steps.expectedResult: A video clip appears on a video track.
The Video panel opens and shows the picture at the playhead; the sound plays through the video's track.

blocks.text: The Video panel can be docked or floated like any panel. The picture is drawn on the graphics card, and its resolution follows the size of the panel: a bigger window gives a sharper picture. A status strip under the picture reports what the video side is doing.
The video is stored inside the project and read from it in pieces while it plays; it is not copied out to a file.
Video can be layered and lightly effected but cannot yet be rendered out as a finished video file. Some containers and codecs (MKV, WebM, HEVC) depend on codecs installed in Windows.
